name: Illuminated normally-open pushbutton
summary: An illuminated NO pushbutton combines a manual normally-open contact function with an indication lamp.
description: An illuminated NO pushbutton combines a manual normally-open contact function with an indication lamp. The lamp circuit is drawn or referenced separately because its indication need not follow the contact state.
readingNotes: Trace the lamp supply independently from the pushbutton contact circuit.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An illuminated actuator does not make its contact a lamp-test contact.
